background_story: Karson was a quirky and charismatic individual who had a unique passion - waste management. As a leading expert in the field, he dedicated his life to finding innovative solutions to the world's growing feculence problem. Karson's fascination with fecal matter began during his college days, where he spent countless hours studying the intricacies of sewage systems. His friends and family often joked that he had a 'crappy' job, but Karson took pride in his work, knowing that it had a direct impact on public health. Through his tireless efforts, Karson developed a revolutionary new system for processing human waste, turning it into a valuable resource for agriculture and energy production. His work earned him the nickname 'The Feculence Guru,' and his contributions to the field have made a significant difference in the lives of people around the world.
